item.title: Rethinking Transit-Oriented Development: Territorial restructuring, intermodality and governance
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines transit-oriented development through the lens of territorial restructuring, intermodality, and governance. The collection seeks to advance understanding of how transit-oriented development reshapes territorial organization and urban structure, the role of integrated multimodal transportation systems in contemporary urban planning, and the governance frameworks that enable or constrain effective transit-oriented development strategies.

Appel publié par Journal of Transport Geography. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Intermodality
  • Governance
